purpose: Resolve products by exact source product_id or product_identifier under one tenant.
ambiguity_behavior: If the exact identifier is missing, leave the source record unresolved.

purpose: Resolve product versions by tenant, canonical product, and normalized revision/version.
ambiguity_behavior: If product or revision cannot be resolved, require human review.

purpose: Resolve approved source product-version aliases preserved by ingestion.
ambiguity_behavior: Alias collisions become AMBIGUOUS and do not create authoritative links.

purpose: Resolve supplier source aliases only from controlled supplier alias fields.
Resolve components by component identifier plus revision.
Resolve manufacturing sites by controlled site identifier.
Resolve lots by tenant, lot identifier, product version, and site context.
ambiguity_behavior: Missing product/site context produces warning provenance but not a false merge.

purpose: Resolve requirements by requirement identifier and product context.
ambiguity_behavior: Requirement text similarity is never an authoritative match.

purpose: Resolve changes by explicit change identifier.
ambiguity_behavior: Shared dates or similar descriptions are not enough to merge changes.

purpose: Preserve complaint identity by exact complaint source identifier.
ambiguity_behavior: Similar complaint narratives are preserved as distinct unless an explicit duplicate rule exists.

purpose: Resolve investigations by exact source investigation identifier.
ambiguity_behavior: Investigation topic similarity is not enough to merge records.

purpose: Resolve evidence metadata and evidence files by evidence identifier or filename.
ambiguity_behavior: Evidence text similarity is not used for authoritative identity resolution.

purpose: Resolve risks by exact risk identifier and product context.
ambiguity_behavior: Risk text similarity is not used for authoritative merging.

purpose: Resolve failure modes by exact failure mode identifier.
ambiguity_behavior: Similar labels are not enough to merge failure modes.

purpose: Resolve controls by exact control identifier.
ambiguity_behavior: Controls with similar descriptions remain distinct unless identifiers match.
